title: Proof audit exercise
source:
Claim C001.
Let p_n be positive integers with p_n/sqrt(n) -> 0. Suppose real random variables R_n satisfy R_n=O_p(p_n/sqrt(n)).
Then R_n=o_p(1).
Proof. The sequence sqrt(n)R_n/p_n is stochastically bounded.
Multiplying that sequence by the deterministic factor p_n/sqrt(n), which tends to zero, proves the claim.
